name: vibe-techdesign
title_zh: 先写技术设计再写代码，让 MVP 不返工
tagline_zh: 当你纠结“该用什么栈、怎么搭”时，它不替你做决定，而是把选项、权衡、风险摊成一张表，让讨论有锚点、决策有痕迹。
tagline_en: Stuck on stack or structure? It won't decide for you—it lays out options, trade-offs, and risks as a table, so.
desc_en: Create a Technical Design Document for your MVP. Use when the user wants to plan architecture, choose tech stack, or says "plan technical design", "choose tech stack", or "how should I build this".
why_zh: 它把散落的“我觉得”逼成“因为…所以…”，用模板强制你写清约束、备选与放弃理由，让技术评审从拍脑袋变成。
why_en: It forces scattered opinions into 'because… therefore…' by templating constraints, alternatives, and rejections—turning gut-feel.
limit_zh: 只产出文档，不写代码、不跑验证。若你已确定技术栈且无评审需求，或团队习惯口头决策，它只会增加文书负担。
limit_en: Outputs a doc only—no code, no validation. If stack is fixed and no review is needed, or your team decides verbally, it's just extra paperwork.
title_en: Write the tech design first, so your MVP survives
